Irradiance Volumes

Each environment box (EnvMapEffectBox) lights the area inside it with a baked irradiance volume. Boxes are linked to volumes as the game links them: by the volume ID property when it is 0 or more, or else by the last three characters of the name (Env_Box203 is volume 203). The game skips boxes that aren't a Box shape or whose name isn't exactly 10 characters. Vanilla boxes leave the property at -1; Fill Volume IDs writes the ID the name gives into it, which changes nothing in game but keeps the link if the box is renamed. One undo reverts it.
